metaDescription: Learn what to expect from a Penn KDSAP community kidney health screening or request a screening for your organization.
title: Free screenings built with local partners
summary: Trained Penn student volunteers and supervising physicians bring screening activities, education, and on-site consultation to community locations.
heroImageAlt: Penn KDSAP volunteers working at a community screening
journeyIntroduction: Trained student volunteers guide participants through a series of stations, with physicians on site to supervise and discuss results.
journeyGraphicDescription: An animated path connects eight stages from welcome and registration through a physician conversation and next steps.
journeyDisclaimer: The exact stations and services can vary by event. Screening information supports an on-site physician conversation and is not a diagnosis by itself.

journeySteps.title: Welcome and registration
journeySteps.text: Check in with the team and learn how the screening will flow.

journeySteps.title: Medical history
journeySteps.text: Share relevant health and family-history information with a trained volunteer.

journeySteps.title: Blood pressure
journeySteps.text: A cuff measurement helps identify a major kidney-health risk factor.

journeySteps.title: BMI measurement
journeySteps.text: Height and weight measurements provide additional health context.

journeySteps.title: Urinalysis
journeySteps.text: A urine dipstick screens for findings such as protein that may merit follow-up.

journeySteps.title: Blood glucose
journeySteps.text: A glucose measurement provides information related to diabetes risk.

journeySteps.title: Health education
journeySteps.text: Review practical, plain-language kidney-health information and resources.

journeySteps.title: Physician conversation
journeySteps.text: Discuss the screening information and appropriate next steps with an on-site physician.

sectionTitle: A screening starts with a local partnership
sectionText: Each event is coordinated with the host organization. Available stations and services may vary by event, and visitors receive instructions from the screening team on site.

steps.title: Welcome
steps.text: Volunteers explain the event flow and help visitors begin the screening process.

steps.title: Screening stations
steps.text: Trained students support the measurements and activities planned for that event under clinical supervision.

steps.title: Health education
steps.text: Visitors can review plain-language kidney health information and ask general questions.

steps.title: Physician consultation
steps.text: When included in the event, a physician discusses results and appropriate next steps directly with the visitor.
